title: Single cell analysis revealed SFRP2 cancer associated fibroblasts drive tumorigenesis in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
authors: Wang, Qiwei; Zhao, Yinan; Tan, Guolin; Ai, JinGang
one_liner_zh: 该文通过单细胞分析鉴定HNSCC中SFRP2_CAF亚型及其与巨噬细胞互作，虽涉及转录因子NFIX调控，但核心是肿瘤微环境与临床关联，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Understanding the mechanisms of invasion and metastasis in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is crucial for effective treatment, particularly in metastatic cases. In this study, we analyzed multicenter bulk sequencing and comprehensive single-cell data from 702,446 cells, leading to the identification of a novel subtype of cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs), termed Secreted Frizzled-Related Protein2 CAFs (SFRP2_CAFs). These cells, originating from smooth muscle cells, display unique characteristics resembling both myofibroblastic CAFs and inflammatory CAFs, and are linked to poorer survival outcomes in HNSCC patients. Our findings reveal significant interactions between SFRP2_CAFs and SPP1 tumor-associated macrophages, which facilitate tumor invasion and metastasis. Moreover, our research identifies Nuclear factor I/X (NFIX) as a key transcription factor regulating SFRP2_CAFs behavior, confirmed through gene regulatory network analysis and simulation perturbation.
abstract_zh: 理解头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSCC）中侵袭和转移的机制对于有效治疗至关重要，尤其是在转移性病例中。在本研究中，我们分析了来自702,446个细胞的多中心批量测序和全面的单细胞数据，从而识别出一种新型的癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）亚型，称为分泌型卷曲相关蛋白2 CAFs（SFRP2_CAFs）。这些细胞起源于平滑肌细胞，展现出类似肌成纤维细胞CAFs和炎症性CAFs的独特特征，并与HNSCC患者较差的生存结局相关。我们的发现揭示了SFRP2_CAFs与SPP1肿瘤相关巨噬细胞之间的显著相互作用，这些相互作用促进了肿瘤的侵袭和转移。此外，我们的研究通过基因调控网络分析和模拟扰动，确认了核因子I/X（NFIX）是调控SFRP2_CAFs行为的关键转录因子。
